title: An EC2 instance's CloudWatch metrics over a window

periodSeconds.description: The CloudWatch period of each datapoint: 300 up to a 3-day window, 3600 above. The first datapoint can cover less than a full period and the last is still filling

instanceState.description: running, stopped... as EC2 reports; a stopped instance publishes no metrics

burstable.description: A T-family type; only then cpuCredits is read

hasData.description: CPUUtilization has datapoints in the window; false: CloudWatch has nothing for the instance (stopped, just launched, or the metrics are not in yet), which says nothing about its load; null when the CPUUtilization call failed

averagePercent.description: CPUUtilization average over the window, weighted by each datapoint's sample count; null with no datapoints

maxPercent.description: Highest CPUUtilization maximum of any period

cpu.description: null when the CPUUtilization call failed

inBytes.description: Sum of NetworkIn over the window; null with no datapoints (unknown, not 0) or when the call failed

hasData.description: Either metric has datapoints; null when both calls failed

readBytes.description: Sum of EBSReadBytes over the window; null with no datapoints (an instance with no EBS volume publishes none) or when the call failed

hasData.description: Any of the four has datapoints; null when all four calls failed

minimum.description: The lowest CPUCreditBalance of the window; null with no datapoints

average.description: Mean of the per-period average balances

usage.description: Sum of CPUCreditUsage: credits spent in the window

hasData.description: CPUCreditBalance has datapoints; null when its call failed

cpuCredits.description: null for a type that has no CPU credits

datapoints.description: Datapoints CloudWatch returned per metric; 0 means no data in the window; null means the call failed or, for the credit metrics, the type has none

cpuAverageAboveThreshold.description: cpu.averagePercent > the cpuUtilizationThreshold setting (strictly); null with no CPU data

cpuMaxAboveThreshold.description: cpu.maxPercent > the cpuUtilizationThreshold setting (strictly); null with no CPU data

cpuCreditBalanceBelowThreshold.description: cpuCredits.minimum < the cpuCreditBalanceThreshold setting (strictly); null for a type without CPU credits and with no credit data
